financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Maxim-placed public offering of 2,000,000 units at $4.00 (stock or pre-funded warrant plus Class E and F warrants), net of 7% placement fee, before other expenses; delivery expected on or about the trough date
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Delivery of the securities hereby is expected to be made on or about July 30, 2025, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.

warrants.quote: Each warrant will be immediately exercisable for one share of common stock at an exercise price equal to 100% of the public offering price per Unit
